justification: Bug fix in data mapping logic — wrong DB field name caused silent data loss for FSR override detection. No new external integrations, no schema changes.

pre_impl.existing_data: housing_sepp_standards table — LMR types have standard_type='max_fsr', secondary_dwelling has 'max_floor_area'
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Previous code assumed 'max_gfa' key existed — it never did for LMR types, so max_fsr was always None
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Fix applies to all existing rows — no data migration needed, only code-side field mapping

functions.name: _build_sepp_housing
functions.input: list[dict] raw rows from housing_sepp_standards DB query
functions.output: list[SEPPStandard] — now correctly populates max_fsr for LMR and max_gfa_m2 for secondary_dwelling
functions.if_none: Returns SEPPStandard with max_fsr=None and max_gfa_m2=None — safe, just missing data

functions.name: _detect_sepp_lep_overrides
functions.output: list[SeppLepOverride] — now uses std.max_fsr instead of std.max_gfa_m2
functions.if_none: If max_fsr is None, FSR comparison skipped — no false positive

values.if_missing: FSR override detection skipped — no false positive

values.guard_at: N/A — stored directly in model field
values.if_missing: max_gfa_m2=None on SEPPStandard — correct for LMR types

break_it.scenario: DB has a standard_type that is neither 'max_fsr' nor 'max_floor_area' but represents FSR
break_it.what_happens: FSR value falls into additional_standards dict, not mapped to max_fsr field
break_it.how: Verified against create_housing_sepp_standards.py — all LMR FSR values use 'max_fsr' as standard_type
break_it.repro: SELECT DISTINCT standard_type FROM housing_sepp_standards WHERE standard_type LIKE '%fsr%'

break_it.scenario: Frontend HousingSEPPEligibilityCard expects max_gfa_m2 for LMR types
break_it.what_happens: Would show null instead of FSR value
break_it.how: Frontend eligibility route (route.ts:348) already correctly matches on 'max_fsr' standard_type — separate codepath
break_it.repro: Grep for max_fsr in frontend — confirmed at eligibility/route.ts:348 and HousingSEPPEligibilityCard.tsx:93

break_it.scenario: Granny flat report page reads max_gfa_m2 from outputs
break_it.what_happens: No impact — granny flat report uses different data source, not SEPPStandard model
break_it.how: granny-flat/[report_id]/page.tsx reads from pipeline outputs, not intelligence_brief.py
break_it.repro: Read granny-flat report page — uses outputs.max_gfa_m2 from granny flat pipeline

post_merge.manual_verify: No — all existing data works correctly with the fix, no migration needed
